projectDescription: Jurni is a private iPhone travel-day command center that organizes flights, hotels, and every stop into one smart itinerary — with timing checks, offline documents, group planning, and a focused daily brief for the day of travel.
keyFeatures: Daily Brief — focused travel-day view of your next 24 hours, QR codes, addresses, and key actions
Smart Import — turn booking confirmation emails and screenshots into trip details automatically
Timing Checks — flags tight connections, overlaps, and lodging gaps before travel day
Offline Documents — boarding passes, hotel confirmations, passports, and PDFs available without internet
One Clean Timeline — flights, trains, hotels, restaurants, and custom stops in a single itinerary
Group Planning — invite travelers, split expenses, calculate balances, and run polls
Trip Maps — every stop and route displayed in context
Widgets & Shortcuts — next step on the iPhone Home Screen; App Intents for fast travel-day actions
Your Story / Passport — travel stats, milestone badges, trophy room, and end-of-trip summaries
3D Globe — interactive globe showing visited destinations and flight paths
End-to-end encryption — AES-256-GCM with keys stored in Apple Keychain, never on servers
Sign in with Apple — no separate password required
publicApiSurface: Smart Import (email, screenshot, pasted itinerary parsing)
